scope: WP-02 supported go.mod version and toolchain directive syntax

attempts.name: regression reproduction before fix
attempts.observation: Invalid go 01.25 and toolchain unsupported declarations were reported complete; valid go 1.26rc1 was rejected.

behavior.go_version_syntax: Matches Go 1.27.3 module parser accepted forms, including prerelease suffixes and rejection of leading-zero components.
behavior.toolchain_syntax: Accepts default or names beginning go1 followed by end-of-name or a dot, matching Go 1.27.3 module parser forward-compatible syntax.
behavior.block_context: Rejects module, go, and toolchain top-level directives inside require or other directive blocks.
behavior.runtime_compatibility: Not checked; declared toolchain is retained as an unknown review item.

remaining: Go and TOML remain static parser subsets; broader directive and real-project coverage is open.
This evidence is unit/full-tree verification, not CLI acceptance of each new syntax case or real-project precision validation.
Windows strict I/O and native platform acceptance remain open.
The complete WP-00 through WP-14 goal remains PARTIAL.
